title: equinor aker make gas find balder field 2026 08 24
text:
COPENHAGEN, Aug 24 (Reuters) - Norwegian ‌oil firms Equinor (EQNR.OL)
, opens new tab
 and Aker BP (AKRBP.OL)
, opens new tab
 have ​discovered gas in ​the so-called Linga prospect 10 ⁠miles northwest of ​the Balder field in ​the North Sea, the Norwegian offshore directorate said on ​Monday.
Preliminary estimates ​put the size of the ‌discovery ⁠at between 0.1 and 2.1 million standard cubic metres of ​recoverable ​oil ⁠equivalent, the offshore directorate said.
Equinor ​operates the prospect ​and ⁠holds a 60% stake, while Aker ⁠BP ​owns the ​remaining 40%.
